Bibarel

Normal Water

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Bibarel is a Normal/Water-type Beaver Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 31.5 kg. It evolves from Bidoof. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 410.
